question: How has Lewes-san been celebrating Garfiel's birthday up until now?
answer: Garfiel was the youngest one at "Sanctuary", so basically all of the adults adored him. Lewes-san included, everyone in the small village would give him gifts. Having said that, it was a poor place compared to the outside, so they weren't able to give him anything too unusual, but Garfiel was very happy.
